d: Ahead of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to hold an unprecedented trilateral meeting—marking the first time the leaders of these three global superpowers sit down together in the modern era. While each leader walks in with vastly different priorities, from nuclear arms control and trade to regional security, global attention is fixed on what could shape the balance of power for years to come.
